_about: The game's sound files (A6, A6b), by the names in js/audio/sounds.js. Each: { "files": ["<name>-1.mp3", ...], "level": 0-1, "rate": pitch (optional, 1 as recorded) }. A name not listed plays its placeholder made in code (js/audio/synth.js). A file shared by several names is loaded once. Files are made by audio/make-sfx.mjs; sources and licence in audio/elevenlabs-manifest.md. Levels: A6's starting mix, raised a little in S14 for the ball sounds (their volume now also follows the ball's speed and depth, about x0.7 for a typical bounce); the shared bounce is pitched per surface (floor lower, front wall higher). For CP-G to tune by ear. A6b added the dive and the menus (levels set so their peaks sit near the in-code bleeps'); squeak-1/-2.mp3 are shipped but not listed until S14b adds the name (an unknown name is a warning).
